description: Broadcasts the signed transaction of a bridge order built by /bridge/order on its source chain (Solana or any of the seven EVM chains) and waits up to 25 seconds for confirmation. Returns the hash, an explorer link, success, failed or pending, and the deBridge order ids linked to the transaction with a status link to follow the delivery on the destination chain. The wallet keeps its keys; nothing is custodied. Price: $0.002 USDC per call (x402).

chain.description: Source chain of the order: solana, base, ethereum, arbitrum, optimism, polygon, bsc or avalanche

signed_transaction.description: 0x-prefixed signed raw transaction (EVM) or base64 signed transaction (Solana)
